description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry class, specifically testing command and capability advertisement based on runtime feature flags, as well as command lookup functionality.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for InvokeCommandRegistry, testing commands and capability advertisements based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Tests that advertised capabilities respect feature availability flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that capabilities include all optional features when enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Tests that advertised commands respect feature availability flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests that feature commands are included when enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Checks that only supported motion commands are advertised based on flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Ensures SMS search and send commands are correctly split based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies SMS capability is advertised when either SMS path is enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that CallLog commands are excluded when unavailable.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that CallLog capability is excluded when unavailable.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Verifies VoiceWake capability is advertised without corresponding commands.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests that command lookup returns foreground metadata for camera commands.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies lookup returns null for unrecognized commands.

methods.name: defaultFlags
methods.description: Helper method to create default NodeRuntimeFlags with optional feature toggles.

methods.name: assertContainsAll
methods.description: Asserts that all expected values are present in the actual list.

methods.name: assertMissingAll
methods.description: Asserts that none of the forbidden values are present in the actual list.
